C0_X14_FIXED_CONTROL.reason: G05 used the prescribed X14 N_KAN, Initial warm start, same TRAIN roles B/POS_OFF/P_INIT_STUDENT, source masses 0.25/0.25/0.50, task/wind/phase balancing, stride 5, normalized SmoothL1 /3, Adam lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-5, batch=256, max_epochs=60 and patience=8. G05 recorded 756480 TRAIN and 56736 VAL events and passed parity. Re-fitting an identical control is redundant; the historical seed is 2026101802 and is retained as such.

C1_X20_FIXED_INFORMATION.model: same 32-hidden cubic-spline X-KAN and 33x3 W0 as X14
C1_X20_FIXED_INFORMATION.normalizer: preserve all 14 Initial values; estimate only six added means/stds on actual TRAIN episodes
C1_X20_FIXED_INFORMATION.initialization: copy Initial X14 parameters; zero all weights for the six new inputs; verify X20 equals Initial X14 before fitting

C2_X14_ADAPTATION_AWARE.initialization: Initial full X14 encoder and W0; shared encoder and W0 are outer learned parameters
C2_X14_ADAPTATION_AWARE.episode_reset: reset W to the shared learned W0 for each episode
C2_X14_ADAPTATION_AWARE.online_recurrence: for every ready 100Hz event, output beta*clip(W_t^T phi_t,-3,3), then update W with the production gamma, leak=0.002, dt=0.01, PCF surface-eta, and [-60,60] projection; only loss endpoints are sparse stride 5
C2_X14_ADAPTATION_AWARE.loss: SmoothL1(beta*clip(W_t^T phi_t,-3,3)/3,target_clip/3); original target_clip remains m/s^2
C2_X14_ADAPTATION_AWARE.recorded_context: X14 surface and PCF eta are taken from each source episode log; B/POS_OFF logs carry zero PCF eta because PCF coordination was not active for those original collectors. This is an offline recorded-trajectory objective, not closed-loop differentiation.

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.batching: one complete episode per optimizer step

C2_X14_ADAPTATION_AWARE.selection: adaptive applied VAL score; report fixed-W0 and adaptive scores separately

second_seed_role: direction check only; never switch the predesignated flight seed after seeing results
